AboutPage.title: The Birth of Seder
AboutPage.subtitle: Seder was born from a word — and a path.
AboutPage.p1: Beyond the acronym of my initials — Skouri David Raphaël — SEDER embodies a fundamental philosophy: that of Order.
AboutPage.p2: My journey was built on a dual requirement, at the highest level: artistic requirement and business requirement.
AboutPage.p3: I am an artist, an Andalusian singer and Hazan of Moroccan origin, performing regularly at events with a spiritual and folkloric dimension. A great artist is never “simply” an artist. He lives in rigor, precision, attention to detail, mastery of emotion, and respect for execution. This discipline, patiently built, taught me what excellence is. It above all prepared me to recognize it, then to transpose it, with the same requirement, into the business world.
AboutPage.p4: Over the years, my presence at the heart of the community — and the bonds of trust it creates — naturally expanded my role. Gradually, I was no longer expected just on stage: I was asked to carry, coordinate, and secure what played out around it. Responsibilities came, discreetly at first, then with increasing obviousness: organizing weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs, celebrations, in contexts where everything had to be impeccable, fluid, and deeply respectful.
AboutPage.p5: I lived for several years in the United States, and this period expanded my network as much as it refined my perspective. Initially, some doors opened out of kindness: they saw the artist in me. Then the relationship deepened; trust was established. I was entrusted with missions, decisions, sometimes even the coordination of entire teams during travels. I thus learned business from successful people — observing their method, integrating their mentality, and understanding their standards.
AboutPage.p6: Finally, my place within the community has confronted me, more than once, with delicate human situations. I often held the role of mediator: calming, understanding, restoring trust, and seeking a fair outcome. This experience led me to study the psychology of relationships, the mechanics of decisions, and the sometimes subtle balances of power — a pillar of what I have become, and what I build today.
AboutPage.quote1: « Seder: the link between creativity, structure, mediation, and execution. »
AboutPage.p7: Today, in Israel, I am solicited for the same reasons: reliability, discretion, the ability to move forward, and to keep the promise of the result where so many others hit the limits of reality. Seder Group is not an idea on paper; it is the culmination of a lived, proven, and structured journey — an alliance of skills designed to serve, and to accomplish, at the highest level.
AboutPage.p8: In the artistic world, many talents exhaust themselves for lack of structure.
AboutPage.p9: In the business world, many leaders succeed but lose their soul and inner presence.
AboutPage.p10: From this vision, Seder Group is born.

MethodPage.title: The SEDER Method
MethodPage.subtitle: The union of heart and intellect.

tanya.heading: The Tanya and the two forces of being
tanya.text1: In the philosophy of the Tanya, the human being consists of two fundamental forces: the mind (moaḥ) and the heart (lev).
tanya.text2: The mind represents intellect and strategy. The heart represents emotion and expression. The Tanya teaches that man can only reach fulfillment when these two dimensions are unified and harmonized.
tanya.text3: However, this governance does not mean domination or suppression. It means direction and harmony. It is precisely this vision that forms the basis of the SEDER Method.

duality.heading: The Artist and the Businessman
duality.text1: In modern life, these two dimensions often take the form of two archetypes: the artist (emotion, inspiration, creativity) and the businessman (structure, strategy, realization).
duality.text2: These two forces are often perceived as opposites. Yet, according to the logic of the Tanya, they are naturally complementary.
duality.text3: When an artist solely possesses the emotional dimension, the momentum is there, but without structure, creativity may fail to materialize. Conversely, a man who develops only the intellect can build efficient systems, but without the warmth of the heart, his actions lack life and creativity.

benoni.heading: The Benoni model: Dynamic equilibrium
benoni.text1: The Tanya proposes the Benoni model for the majority of men: he is neither a mediocre nor average man, but rather one who possesses opposing forces and knows how to organize them. He does not suppress his impulses; he learns to direct them.
benoni.text2: The Benoni lives by the principle of dynamic equilibrium. His heart feels deeply, but his mind knows how to channel these emotions into constructive action.
benoni.text3: Perfection does not lie in the absence of tension. It lies in the ability to maintain a living balance between inspiration and action.

seder.heading: The SEDER Answer
seder.text1: The SEDER Method applies this principle to contemporary life. The artist brings the vision, the businessman brings the organization.
seder.text2: The word SEDER means Order. The method proposes restoring order among the different human forces. When inspiration, thought, body, and action are aligned, success is no longer an objective—it becomes the natural result of this inner equilibrium.

MethodPage.quote: « Success is not a goal. It is the natural result of inner order. »

method.title: The 5 Foundation Pillars
method.desc: At the core of Seder Group lies the SEDER Method, a philosophy of personal and professional development built around a simple, memorable, and progressive model that unites the businessman's exigency with the artist's flame. This method fits together in harmony through the initials of SEDER.

s.title: Spirituality
s.desc: The foundation of the model. Spirituality represents inner grounding. Without solid values, no success can remain stable over time.
s.keywords: Torah – Ethics – Respect for others – Self-confidence – Trust in God

e1.title: Expression
e1.desc: Expression is the capacity to convey a vision, persuade, and inspire. In the Seder Method, the voice is not merely an artistic tool: it becomes an instrument of leadership and presence.
e1.keywords: Voice – Communication – Leadership – Negotiation – Charisma – Influence

d.title: Discipline
d.desc: Discipline represents the physical and mental capacity to carry a vision over time. It encompasses lifestyle, energy management, stress mastery, and inner stability.

e2.title: Execution
e2.desc: Execution is the moment the vision becomes real, characteristic of the business world. It involves structure, strategy, organization, and consistency.
e2.keywords: Strategy – Organization – Action (Hishtadlut: doing one's part)

r.title: Result
r.desc: When all pillars are aligned, success is no longer a coincidence. It becomes a natural consequence stemming from perfect order.
